coder_notes: Phase 1 single-arm multi-peptide vaccine with XS15 adjuvant in Montanide, on top of standard RT/TMZ. Vaccine, XS15 and Montanide coded as components of one vaccine product (excluded intervention type, shared regimen_id). XS15 flagged uncertain because the record calls it an immunomodulator. HLA-A*02:01 requirement is germline HLA typing and not recorded as a tumour biomarker.
